Big East regular season champions |tourney = [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Sweet Sixteen }} {{2020–21 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Villanova University]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Led by head coach [[Jay Wright (basketball)|Jay Wright]] in his 20th year, the Wildcats played their home games at the [[Finneran Pavilion]] on the school's campus in the [[Philadelphia]] suburb of [[Villanova, Pennsylvania]]. However, they did not play at [[Wells Fargo Center (Philadelphia)|Wells Fargo Center]] due to the COVID-19 pandemic. They are members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 18–7, 11–4 in [[2020–21 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East Play]] to finish as regular season champions. However, star guard [[Collin Gillespie]] suffered a season-ending MCL tear with a single game left in the regular season and were upset in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] by [[2020–21 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2020–21 Winthrop Eagles men's basketball team|Winthrop]] and [[2020–21 North Texas Mean Green men's basketball team|North Texas]], despite the loss of Gillespie and [[Justin Moore (basketball)|Justin Moore]] in the first-round game, to advance to the Sweet Sixteen where they lost to the eventual champions [[2020–21 Baylor Bears basketball team|Baylor]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Wildcats]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 24–7, 13–5 in [[2019–20 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish tied for first place. As the No. 2 seed in the [[2020 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they were slated to play [[2019–20 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|DePaul]] in the quarterfinals, but the Tournament was cancelled at halftime of the first game of the quarterfinals due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], along with the rest of the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA postseason]].{{cite news |last1=Litman |first1=Laken |title=Inside the Chaotic Decision to Cancel the Big East tournament |url=https://www.si.com/college/2020/03/13/big-east-tournament-canceled-inside-decision-coronavirus |access-date=November 27, 2020 |work=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=March 12, 2020}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
